description: Water coming through bedroom ceiling in heavy rain
history: 2026-07-28 Tenant reported leak through bedroom ceiling (portal).
2026-08-04 Islington Roofing attended; tarpaulin fitted over slipped slates as a temporary measure; quote IR-3391 £1,850 inc VAT for slate and flashing repairs.
2026-08-05 Quote sent to landlord for approval (above £500 limit).
2026-08-19 Chased landlord by email; no reply.
2026-09-02 Chased landlord by phone; he said he wanted a second quote.
2026-09-15 Landlord approved IR-3391 by email after the second quote came in higher.
2026-09-16 Islington Roofing booked works for Mon 19 Oct 2026 (scaffold needed; earliest scaffold date).
2026-09-29 Tenant reported more water in the bedroom after storm; roofer re-secured tarpaulin on 2026-09-30.

visit.scope: Scaffold, replace slipped slates, renew lead flashing
